items.desc_en: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.
items.desc_zh: 地方当局称，一名儿童和一名年轻人在事故中丧生，多人受伤。

items.title_en: Tanzanian opposition leader found guilty of incitement
items.title_zh: 坦桑尼亚反对派领导人因煽动罪被判有罪
items.desc_en: The 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, was acquitted of the more serious charge of treason.
items.desc_zh: 这位 58 岁的男子自去年 4 月以来一直被拘留，后来被判无罪释放更严重的叛国罪。

items.title_en: Elon Musk appears to signal the end of the road for Cybertruck
items.title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克似乎预示着赛博卡车之路的终结
items.desc_en: Musk said it was to make room for production of its Cybercabs - autonomous taxis without a driver.
items.desc_zh: 马斯克表示，这是为了为其生产 Cyber​​cabs（没有司机的自动驾驶出租车）腾出空间。

items.title_en: Somalia's top court rejects president's term extension amid political crisis
items.title_zh: 索马里最高法院因政治危机拒绝延长总统任期
items.desc_en: The country's first nationwide elections since 1969 are due next year - a timetable now thrown into doubt.
items.desc_zh: 该国自 1969 年以来的首次全国选举将于明年举行——这一时间表现在受到质疑。

items.title_en: Major construction ongoing near Iran missile bases, satellite images suggest
items.title_zh: 卫星图像显示，伊朗导弹基地附近正在进行重大建设
items.desc_en: Evidence of digging and new buildings are visible in satellite imagery taken in November, satellite images suggest.
items.desc_zh: 卫星图像显示，在 11 月份拍摄的卫星图像中可以看到挖掘和新建筑的证据。
